title: UX in 2027 may be less about interfaces and more about behavior
description: This forward-looking essay explores how UX design is shifting from static interfaces toward adaptive systems and delegated actions, fundamentally changing designer responsibilities. Understanding these emerging trends is critical for staying ahead in a rapidly evolving field.

title: AI operating principles
description: A practical framework outlining five core principles for designers to maintain creative integrity and intentionality as AI tools expand capabilities. Essential reading for navigating the balance between automation and authentic design practice.

title: Neuroqueering design practice
description: This thought-provoking essay examines design through the lens of neurodiversity and queer theory, challenging conventional design thinking. It offers valuable perspective on creating more inclusive and adaptive design practices beyond traditional frameworks.

title: Rethinking success beyond the corporate stairs in the world of design
description: A timely reflection on how AI, metrics-obsession, and career anxiety are reshaping what success means for designers in an unstable professional landscape. Particularly relevant for design leaders and practitioners questioning traditional career trajectories.

title: Gridset: Turn drafts into on-brand documents
description: A practical tool that automates the design-to-document workflow by converting drafts and PDFs into branded outputs in seconds. Demonstrates how AI is streamlining production design work and reducing manual formatting overhead.

title: We used to log off
description: A provocative cultural critique exploring how digital design has erased boundaries between online and offline spaces, making it impossible to truly disconnect. Important perspective on designing for human wellbeing in an always-on world.

title: All in Frame
description: A free stock photography resource curated by disabled creatives that empowers design teams to tell more authentic and inclusive stories about disability. Addresses a critical gap in design assets and democratizes authentic representation.

title: Blank pages, Researcher-in-the-loop, Design's craft crisis
description: A curated digest connecting foundational UX principles (like Nielsen's heuristics) with contemporary design challenges around blank states and research integration. Bridges classic design wisdom with modern application concerns.
